purpose: Track Xiaomi's newly demonstrated XRING AI Cube and distinguish its three memory/compute domains so prototype claims are not misrepresented as shipping-product performance.

processors.name: XRING O3
processors.memory_bandwidth_note: Reported for the O3 system-memory domain; it is not the O100 near-memory figure and not evidence for the D100 large-model memory pool.

processors.name: XRING O100
processors.near_memory_bandwidth_note: 1.22 TB/s is the O100 near-memory bandwidth. It must not be presented as the bandwidth of the full large-model unified-memory pool.

prototype_llm_benchmark.system_context: separate O3+O100 mobile engineering prototype with active cooling
prototype_llm_benchmark.normalization_warning: Model size, quantization, context length, prompt-processing rate and complete-system power were not sufficiently disclosed for cross-platform comparison.

processors.name: XRING D100
processors.large_memory_bandwidth_note: Xiaomi has not publicly disclosed a defensible bandwidth figure for the D100-attached large unified-memory pool in this research pass.

hardware.system_power_note: Reported sustained system performance/power target for the engineering prototype; independent wall-power measurements are not available.
hardware.enclosure: aluminum unibody engineering chassis with 33,874 CNC-machined cooling openings
hardware.framework_compatibility: No public evidence was found for general CUDA, ROCm, MLX, OpenVINO, llama.cpp GGUF, vLLM, GPTQ or AWQ compatibility. Treat the runtime as proprietary until Xiaomi publishes SDK/toolchain details.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Undisclosed. Do not infer INT4/GGUF support from model-capacity or TOPS claims.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: The architecture is relevant to large local models because D100 supports up to 160GB unified memory, but large-model decode performance cannot be estimated defensibly until Xiaomi publishes bandwidth for that memory pool and sufficient 120B benchmark metadata.
llm_suitability.important_correction: The widely repeated 1.22 TB/s figure belongs to O100 near-memory and should not be attached to the 120B model's full weight-storage memory pool.

hardware.efficiency_notes: 150W is notable for a system targeting 120B-class local workloads, but tokens/joule cannot be calculated because the public 120B decode rate and full power measurement are missing.

pricing.note: No retail price, preorder, SKU or firm AI Cube ship date has been announced. O100 and D100 are reported as targeting commercial use in 2027, which does not guarantee a retail AI Cube product.

open_questions: exact AI Cube memory configuration and topology
120B model identity, quantization, context, prefill and decode throughput
retail product status, price and availability
